name: timestamp
description: Ends every reply with a small stamp box showing when the turn started and when the reply was finished, to the second, in the user's own time zone - read from a script on their machine, never guessed by the model. For anyone with many chats open who needs to see at a glance when each one last moved and how long it took. A PreInvocation hook captures the start of each turn automatically; the finish time comes from the same script run once more at the end.
